source: PMC4504541, author histology roster and primary IVIM method/schema; reuse existing owner originals
question: Does this measured sarcoma cohort authenticate any EMC enrollment with public all-EMC case-to-IVIM measurement linkage and an unanswered consequential source-specific comparison beyond already published benign/malignant and myxoid ambiguity?
allowed_fields: Source disease/diagnostic labels and counts, all generic labels
Donor/case identifiers and explicit measurement-row crosswalk, not inferred by endpoint/order/age
MRI acquisition model, b-values, parameter units and fitted-signal fraction interpretation
Supplement schema/column identifiers and primary prior-art statements without numerical endpoint/threshold outcomes
values_masked: No ADC, IVIM D/Dstar/f, fitted numeric values, source diagnostic threshold results, plots or medical-image pixels examined. Source method b-values/acquisition and histologic enrollment counts are permitted.
clock_gate: Initial real clock2026-10-05T13:54:40UTC; America/New_York09:54:40, image ban active. Quiet API/files/PDF text only until14UTC. Immediately check actual UTC clock before any roster-only graphical inspection after14UTC; no DICOM, clinical pixels or endpoint plots. Do not label future inspection already completed.
prospective_disproof: No actual EMC label or unresolved generic source enrollment identity
Primary already establishes proposed contrast, or simple source eligibility cannot change a useful measurement decision
ROI, donor overlap, treatment or incompatible acquisition precludes source-supported all-EMC comparison
one_conditional_future_contrast: Only if genuine identity and public all-EMC linkage exist, a future dated BEFORE-VALUES plan must fix one consequential published-rule/subtype or source-matched within-donor contrast, source units/ROI/acquisition, exact comparator, all conditions, missingness, donor uncertainty and strongest alternative. This gate does not authorize numbers or invent a threshold.
assay_meaning: IVIMf is fitted diffusion-signal fraction under a model, not directly measured blood flow, oxygen tension, vessel density or endothelial-cell count. ADC and IVIM parameters cannot be pooled as one physical measurement.
strongest_alternatives: Myxoid free water, cellularity and fit degeneracy
B-value sampling, low-b noise, motion and ROI/necrosis
Source diagnostic class, site/grade/treatment and donor/case reuse
coverage: All actual EMC and generic labels preserved, measured eligibility distinct from analyzability. Missing metadata or failed route remains pending, not negative. OA API404 does not prove no PDF or EMC. Primary prior art and existing MRI negative/linkage gates reused.

operational.new_original_policy: Zero-copy preferred; any full original ignored cache-only with exact hashes; no full queries/papers in Git
operational.restrictions: Preserve original IG/MRI/oxygen freezes; no restricted FAP/glycan/structural/HLA content, no private/paid/spend/outreach/publication, no root edits/pushes; Codex author and committer.
